messages:
Olivia: Heads up — HelixCorp CISO just pinged Mia about the Proof-of-Concept. They want 3 things before board review: (1) egress encryption attestation (BYO KMS / HSM proof), (2) ability to lock egress to their VPC endpoints, and (3) clear pricing comparison: hosted vs Dedicated reserved for ~10M tokens/month. Board signoff window = Fri COB. Can we assemble an internal bridge? :rotating_light:

Sam: assigning to me for tech pricing + POC plan. Quick Q: do they explicitly require HSM attestation (cert chain) or will a redacted attestation doc suffice?

Olivia: They said HSM-level attestation preferred, but legal will accept a redacted signed attestation if we can’t provide full cert chain immediately. Also asked for redacted SOC2 pages.

Jin: For BYO KMS + egress restriction we need two things from their infra team: peering details + allowed CIDR ranges and an mTLS cert for the peering endpoint. ETA to produce an internal attestation draft: ~36 hrs. Example config snippet I can provide for the bridge call:
```yaml
network:
  egress: "restricted"
  allowed_cidrs: ["10.10.0.0/16"]
  kms: "external"
  kms_mode: "bring-your-own"
```

Maria: Legal here — we can share a redacted SOC2 summary and sign an attestation template. Pricing: need clarification if they want reserved capacity (committed throughput) or pay-as-you-go. Reserved commitment gives discounts: 20% (12mo) / 30% (24mo). Drafting bridge language now.

Alex: Suggest we run two internal calls: Thu pre-ops sync to validate infra & attestation, Fri exec bridge for CISO+CTO with our CTO + legal. I can join Fri 10am PT. Olivia, please set invites and include pricing slide + attestation draft + network diagram.

Olivia: Proposed schedule: Thu 9am PT — pre-ops (SRE + SE + Jin); Fri 10am PT — exec bridge. @devops-bot can you spin up a short-lived prebake env for the demo and a sample network diagram?

devops-bot: Prebake env created: rbw-prebake-helix-2445 (48hr lifetime). Demo URL: https://internal.build/rbw-prebake-2445. Template network diagram uploaded to /shared/bridges/helix-2445-diagram.png :robot_face:

Sam: I'll prepare a one-slide cost calc showing per-token hosted vs reserved Dedicated for 10M tokens/month plus an overage scenario. Also prepping a short runbook: if Dedicated provisioning lags, we present the hosted fallback + canary policy.

Jin: One technical blocker: their infra team uses a NIC driver we haven't validated in our private package (kernel 1.4 path expectation). Need eng-infra support to validate image compatibility. Pinging eng-infra channel after this thread.

Olivia: Action items (internal):
- Sam: pricing slide + runbook by EOD tomorrow
- Jin: attestation draft + config snippets in 36 hrs
- Maria: redacted SOC2 + bridge legal language in 24 hrs
- Alex: send exec invites and marshal leadership availability
- Eng-infra: validate NIC driver compatibility (Jin will paste logs)

Maria: Also flag: HelixCorp asked about a "no-logs" route for specific endpoints. That has compliance implications — I'll need product + infra input before promising anything.

Alex: Understood. We should not commit to no-logs without a compliance review. If bridge goes well, target 12mo reserved deal. No objections? :thumbsup:

Olivia: No objections. I'll create the calendar invites and share a single slide pack (pricing + attestation summary + network diagram) before the Thu sync.

Sam: I'll post the cost calc and a simple canary rollback snippet here when ready.

Jin: I'll follow up with eng-infra and paste the driver logs in eng-infra channel now.

Olivia: Thanks everyone — keeping this thread as the single source of truth for prep. If anything changes ping me directly.
